title: Bold consumer visual direction
summary: A single hero brand hue paired with inky black and off-white, carrying a punchy, playful, energetic consumer identity without competing colors.
defaults: Hue: one hero brand hue (Klarna pink #FFB3C7 in the reference) dominating identity, always paired with inky black text
Surface: warm off-white background; the hero hue may own large identity areas but never body text or gradients
Density: compact consumer density with big tactile buttons and clear primary paths
Keep the hero color off large-body typography and multi-hue combinations
risks: A second saturated hue diluting the hero color
Hero-hue text on the light surface (or inverse) failing contrast floors
Accent overuse turning playful visual energy into noise
verification: One hero hue carries the identity and no second saturated hue competes
Button text reaches 3:1 and body text 4.5:1 contrast

example_startups.name: Klarna
example_startups.note: One signature pink (#FFB3C7) as the sole color, always with inky black and off-white, never on body text

visual_rules: Use exactly one signature accent color, sparingly, for identity and primary CTAs
Derive all neutral tones from one base hue at varying opacities; never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF
Keep body text contrast at least 4.5:1 and button or CTA contrast at least 3:1 against adjacent colors
Never combine three or more saturated hues in one view
